education_level_institution_type.label: Education level / institution type
education_level_institution_type.value: Postsecondary education holding company: American Military University, American Public University, Rasmussen University, Hondros College of Nursing

program_qualification.label: Program / qualification
program_qualification.value: Degree, certificate and diploma programs; pre-licensure ADN and practical nursing, medical assisting, and military-focused degrees

tuition_payment_model.label: Tuition / payment model
tuition_payment_model.value: Low-cost tuition emphasizing affordability; also employer alliances for nursing students

accreditation_authorization.label: Accreditation / authorization
accreditation_authorization.value: Institutional accreditation from the Higher Learning Commission for American Public University System; programmatic accreditation for select programs

delivery_campus_model.label: Delivery / campus model

notes: Enrollment count and outcome figures are not given in the evidence lines; tuition model is only described as low-cost.
